description: Yandex's own view of a project's domain: the indexing summary — including the Site Quality Index (SQI), a third independent authority signal alongside OpenPageRank and Tranco — and popular search queries, read straight from the Yandex Webmaster API. FREE (no credits). Bring-your-own-token: requires the deployment operator to set YANDEX_WEBMASTER_OAUTH_TOKEN (one token covers every host verified on that Yandex account — no per-project connect step, and MisarSEO never drives the OAuth flow itself). Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_host' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account. Yandex publishes no backlink-lookup endpoint at all, so unlike get_bing_site_overview this has no backlinks section. `diagnostics` lists individually named issues (e.g. NO_SITEMAPS, DNS_ERROR) that `summary.siteProblems` only counts by severity.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_yandex_site_overview
